transcript.text: I was thinking about that work trip back in 2025—ended up bouncing between Beijing and Shanghai, and it felt like the whole week was just trains and airports.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Shanghai itself was great though—everyone kept talking about where to stay in the city, like it’s a whole topic on its own.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: My friend was the one who handled the flight stuff, and I remember the ticket was for 2025-03-25—honestly I didn’t even see the details until later.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: After the fact I noticed it was Air China, flight CA1234, and it was booked under Zhang Wei—so yeah, definitely not my doing.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And for the hotel, we stayed at Hyatt on the Bund—check-in was 2025-03-18 for 2 nights, and the reservation name was Zhou Jun.
